contact.basis: Approximate pavement outside the Kennedy Road entrance.

attribution: Lands Department, Hong Kong SAR Government
method: Unchanged 5 m grid values were cropped from the official ArcInfo ASCII file. The site field uses bilinear interpolation after the WGS84-to-HK1980 grid conversion.
limitations: The 5 m government grid includes some raised features and gives approximate local grade. The 2 m output resamples those original 5 m observations.
